subject: BluePeak Exec Workshop - Visitor Onboarding & Access Delegation
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@bluepeak.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: BluePeak Security Ops <security@bluepeak.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Visitor badging & pre-clearance for June 28 exec workshop

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Quick note as we lock logistics for the June 28 workshop at our San Mateo office — Security wants a pre-registered list and a delegation policy for any guests that need escorting. Can you confirm the process for: 
- Pre-registering external guests (DFAs and contractors)
- Which Redwood attendees can approve temporary badges on arrival
- How we handle PII in the manifest (SSNs/IDs — do we need truncated copies?)

We have limited kiosk stations on site; ideally your team can provide a CSV by EOD Monday the 21st so our badge vendor can pre-print temporary passes. Also attach your standard badging template if you have one.

Thanks — Anna
Anna Lopez
Director, Events & Facilities | BluePeak Financial
anna.lopez@bluepeak.com
(415) 555-0113

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, BluePeak Security Ops <security@bluepeak.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Visitor badging & pre-clearance for June 28 exec workshop

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up. Outline below is what we've used successfully for previous exec workshops; attaching our badging_template.xlsx and the current onsite-map.png for routing. Key asks and constraints: 

1) Pre-registration CSV (what we can provide)
- Fields we will supply: first_name, last_name, email, company, role, arrival_window (15-min buckets), host (Redwood rep), mobile (optional).
- We do NOT collect SSNs or full government IDs. If BluePeak requires a scanned ID for entry, please confirm a secure transfer channel (SFTP or encrypted Box link).

2) Badge approvers and delegation flow
- Primary approver: Ben Carter (Sales lead) — can approve up to 12 temporary badges.
- Secondary approver: Marissa Cole (Events) — fallback if Ben is delayed.
- Escalation: If neither approver is present, Vivek Kulkarni (Security liaison) will hold authority for VIPs only.

3) Escorting and unescorted access
- Guests from partner companies may be granted unescorted access only after BluePeak Security Ops confirms identity at kiosk and confirms their badge status in the printed manifest. 
- All contractors and vendors require an escort for the first 30 minutes or while moving to unsecured areas.

4) Onsite manifest handling & PII
- Redwood will provide a manifest with no government ID numbers. For any ID checks BluePeak requires, we'll ask visitors to present IDs at the desk — BluePeak Security can retain an encrypted copy if policy requires.

5) Timeline
- Draft manifest (CSV) from Redwood: Tue 21 Jun 17:00 PT
- Final manifest to security vendor for pre-print: Wed 22 Jun 12:00 PT

Next steps: Ben, can you confirm primary approver permissions and your availability to sign off on the manifest on 21 Jun? Vivek, will you be available as escalation lead on 28 Jun?

Best,

Marissa Cole
Events & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0199

Attachments: badging_template.xlsx (Excel, 34KB), onsite-map.png (PNG, 210KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, BluePeak Security Ops <security@bluepeak.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Visitor badging & pre-clearance for June 28 exec workshop

Marissa — I confirm I can be primary approver and will be available Jun 21 for manifest sign-off. A few clarifications: 
- We will limit Redwood non-employee access to 10 concurrent guests in the main conference zone; after that we need BluePeak approval for overflow.
- For VIPs (C-suite), I'll approve unescorted access but will notify your security team (Vivek) ahead of arrival.

Action: Marissa, I'll review the draft CSV and send one-line approval no later than 17:30 PT on the 21st.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Final visitor manifest and delegation matrix — Jun 28 workshop

Hi — attached is the final visitor-manifest.csv (redacted for PII) and a short delegation matrix. Per prior notes: badging vendor will use the attached CSV for pre-print and we will bring a single encrypted manifest on a corporate device for on-site reconciliation. Please confirm receipt and whether we should route any IDs via secure Box link.

Quick summary of the manifest: 23 external guests, 5 Redwood staff, 2 partner vendors. Key VIPs listed in first column. Approvers: Ben Carter (primary), Marissa Cole (secondary), Vivek Kulkarni (escalation for security exceptions).

If BluePeak Security Ops confirms pre-printing, we'll instruct guests to pick up badges at the south kiosk between 08:15–08:45. If anything changes on your side please flag before 10:00 PT on Jun 22.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth arrival.

Marissa Cole
Events & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
